Name: Simple Locked Chests
Author: TechM0nkey
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D2691E]Simple Locked Chests[/color][/size]
[i]Keep your special items safe in multiplayer! A friendly way to preserve your treasures while farming together.[/i][/center]

[line]

[size=5][color=#90EE90][b]⚿ Core Functionality ⚿[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*] Press F9 while facing a chest to lock/unlock it (configurable keybind)
[*] Locked chests stay private to their owner
[*] Game host enforces locks automatically - friends don't need the mod to respect your locked chests
[*] Only players with the mod installed can create new locks on chests
[/list]

[size=5][color=#FFD700][b]✦ Visual Lock Indicators ✦[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*] 6 helpful icon styles: Key, Lock, Cross, Star, Heart, X
[*] Different styles for your chests vs. your friends' chests
[*] Adjustable icon size and positioning (5 vertical positions from above chest to bottom)
[*] [color=#FF6B35]Note:[/color] Icons may occasionally overlap with players due to game rendering mechanics
[/list]

[size=5][color=#87CEEB][b]⚙ Settings & Integration ⚙[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*] Toggle icons and hover text on/off, separate controls for your chests vs. friends' chests
[*] Compatible with Chests Anywhere and All Chests Menu mods
[*] Your private chests stay out of shared chest browsers
[/list]

[line]

[size=5][color=#98FB98]Installation[/color][/size]

[color=#87CEEB][b]Vortex:[/b][/color] Download and enable through Vortex mod manager

[color=#87CEEB][b]Manual:[/b][/color] Extract to your Stardew Valley/Mods/ directory (requires SMAPI)

[size=5][color=#FFD700]How to Use[/color][/size]
[list=1]
[*] Stand next to any player chest and press F9 to lock/unlock
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configuration
[/list]

[size=5][color=#98FB98]Requirements[/color][/size]
[list]
[*] SMAPI 3.14.0+ and Stardew Valley 1.5+
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (recommended)
[/list]

[center][i]Perfect for multiplayer farms where you want to maintain some privacy while collaborating with friends![/i][/center]

Manifest.Name: Simple Locked Chests
Manifest.Description: Simple chest locks: Open or Locked. First opener becomes the owner. GMCM support. Compatible with ChestsAnywhere and AllChestsMenu.
